about_the_game:
Aqua Corner transforms the corner of your desktop into a tranquil aquatic paradise, fitting perfectly into your daily routine! Whether you're working, studying, or simply relaxing, your personal aquarium is always within view. Enjoy the calming presence of your fish, nurture them at your own pace, and create your ultimate dream desktop aquarium.

ADOPT AND NURTURE ADORABLE FISH

Populate your Aqua Corner with a variety of charming fish species. From playful guppies to majestic angelfish, each fish has unique needs and personalities. Feed them regularly to keep them happy and watch as they generate hearts and coins, rewarding your care and attention. Ensure their well-being and witness your aquatic companions thrive!

GIF - Fish Variety + Pet Fish + Heart Generation

DECORATE AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR AQUARIUM

Your aquarium is a canvas for your creativity. Select from a wide range of decorations, including vibrant corals, serene underwater plants, and cute whimsical accessories. Customize the floor texture, adjust the lighting, and even change the water's color and opacity to create the perfect ambience. Design a peaceful retreat or a lively underwater spectacle – the choice is yours!

GIF - Shop & Decoration Mechanics

LEVEL UP AND UNLOCK NEW FISH SPECIES

Nurture your fish to increase their happiness and watch them level up! As your fish grow, you'll unlock new and exciting species, each with unique appearances and abilities. Experiment with different combinations to discover rare and extraordinary fish, expanding your aquatic collection.

GIF - Fish Level and Exp System

COLLECT AND SHOWCASE YOUR AQUATIC ACHIEVEMENTS

Keep track of your fish collection and achievements with an interactive in-game journal. This vibrant compendium showcases all the fish species you've collected, organized by type and rarity. Each new discovery is added to your journal, creating a colorful and rewarding record of your progress. Whether you're a dedicated collector or simply enjoy the thrill of discovery, your journal will be a treasured reminder of your aquatic adventures.

GIF - Fish Journal & Progress Stats

ADD AQUACORNER TO YOUR WISHLIST AND DIVE INTO A WORLD OF CALM!

We are excited to share AquaCorner with you, a project born from our passion for relaxing, creative experiences. We've poured our hearts into crafting a serene and engaging world for you to enjoy.

If AquaCorner has captured your imagination, please add it to your wishlist! Your support helps us continue to develop and expand this tranquil universe. Your aquarium will always be ready, offering a moment of peace and joy, no matter what your day brings. Nurture your fish, customize your environment, and uncover new aquatic wonders with ease and pleasure.

Thank you for joining us on this underwater journey and for helping us bring AquaCorner to life!

name: Aqua Corner

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 @ 3.2 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DirectX 9 support (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible or better (e.g., NVIDIA GTX 750 or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: AquaCorner is a relaxing 3D idle simulation that brings a charming aquarium to your desktop corner! Collect cute fish, nurture them, and decorate their habitat with colorful items. Enjoy this cozy, atmospheric experience and build your dream underwater ecosystem.
supported_languages: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese
